What Soft Summer looks like

Your colouring is blended and low-contrast, with a cool-neutral cast: skin that can look slightly olive or rosy, ash-brown or dark-ash-blonde hair, and grey-blue, grey-green or soft hazel eyes. Greyed, dusty colours such as dusty rose, eucalyptus, faded denim and mauve look expensive on you, while bright, saturated or high-contrast colours wear you instead.

Colours Soft Summer should avoid

Bright White. Too stark; oyster or soft white looks natural on you.

Black. The contrast is harsher than your colouring and hardens your face.

Best metals

Best: Brushed silver. Good: Pewter and soft rose gold. Skip: Shiny yellow gold.

Questions

What colours look best on Soft Summer?

Soft Summer suits colours that are cool-neutral, medium and soft, such as mauve pink, antique rose, soft cranberry, mint grey, soft jade.

What colours should Soft Summer avoid?

Bright White: Too stark; oyster or soft white looks natural on you. Black: The contrast is harsher than your colouring and hardens your face.

Gold or silver for Soft Summer?

Best: Brushed silver. Also good: pewter and soft rose gold. Usually skip: shiny yellow gold.

How do I know if I'm Soft Summer?

Soft Summer colouring is cool-neutral in undertone, medium in depth, low in contrast and soft in chroma. A daylight selfie scan measures all four and shows your closest season plus a runner-up.
